appraisal.ai.approveBody: By approving you state that you reviewed every item, checked the proposed answers and the evidence in the paper, and corrected them where needed.
appraisal.ai.badApprover: The approver must be a person's initials (not “ai” or “consensus”).
appraisal.ai.confirm: I reviewed and checked every item.
appraisal.ai.itemTitle: This item has an AI suggestion with a plain-language rationale — see Why?
appraisal.ai.needConfirm: Tick that you reviewed every item.
appraisal.ai.note: An AI draft is not a second rater: it counts neither in agreement (κ) nor in consensus. The independent second appraisal must be done by a human.
appraisal.ai.noteLabel: Note (optional; goes to the project journal)
appraisal.ai.pending: This is an AI draft: review it item by item (the “Why?” button shows the reasoning and evidence), correct it, then approve it.
appraisal.ai.title: Draft prepared by Claude: unusable until a human approves it, and never counted as a rater.
appraisal.alg.conservative: CONSERVATIVE — what the answers force; NOT the official flowchart
appraisal.alg.count: star count — thresholds are not official
appraisal.alg.none: HOLISTIC — this tool has no algorithm, a human judgement is required
appraisal.alg.validator-compatible: VALIDATOR-COMPATIBLE rule — not the official algorithm
appraisal.am.conv.meets: 'partial yes' on a critical item is not a flaw (meets)
appraisal.am.conv.weakness: 'partial yes' on a critical item is a weakness (weakness)
appraisal.am.hintsNote: This is only a suggestion based on the project files (e.g. PRISMA, protocol); you give the answer.
appraisal.am.hintsTitle: Suggested evidence from the project audit
appraisal.am.ifWeakness: if 'partial yes' on a critical item counted as a weakness →
appraisal.am.intro: Fill in the 16 items for your own review. The engine gives the rating by the published AMSTAR 2 rule, under both 'partial yes' conventions (project convention per KB AMSTAR2-00: 'meets').
appraisal.am.noHints: The project audit gave no suggestion for this review.
appraisal.am.noRating: The rating appears once answered (computed by the engine).
appraisal.am.notGrade: AMSTAR 2 rates confidence in the review's results, not the certainty of the evidence (that is GRADE).
appraisal.am.same: Both conventions lead to the same rating.
appraisal.am.title: AMSTAR 2 — self-check of your own review (16 items, 7 critical)
appraisal.cons.caption: A's and B's answers per item, agreement and decision
appraisal.cons.intro: The two independent human appraisals side by side. Where they differ, decide which is right (and briefly why). Agreement statistics (κ) are computed by the engine.
appraisal.cons.noneReady: No study has two independent human appraisals yet.
appraisal.cons.notReady: Consensus needs two independent human appraisals.
appraisal.cons.pick: Pick a study (consensus is possible only where two independent human appraisals exist):
appraisal.cons.title: Consensus — reconciling two independent raters
appraisal.cons.undecided: Decide every difference (A or B) before saving the consensus.
appraisal.engineMissing: The engine's appraisal functions are not available in this version ({names}): the list is built from the files, without completeness and implied judgements.
appraisal.engineMissingHelp: The instrument definitions, completeness and implied judgements come from the meta-analysis engine. Update the engine and restart the workbench.
appraisal.export.hint: Send the file to the other rater; they add it with “Incoming files” or “Import from file…”.
appraisal.import.badFile: The file is not readable JSON
appraisal.import.tooLarge: The file is too large for browser import
appraisal.import.useInbox: Copy the file into 04_torzitas_kockazat/appraisals/beerkezett/, then import it with the “Incoming files” button.
appraisal.inbox.help: The second rater works on their own machine and sends a file (decision 5). Put the file here: {dir} — it can be imported from there without a size limit.
appraisal.inbox.title: Incoming appraisal files (second rater)
appraisal.intro: What does this tool measure? (for beginners)
appraisal.invalid: The engine did not accept these answers (they do not count until you fix them):
appraisal.legendImplied: dashed outline: the engine's implied judgement (a suggestion, not an official result)
appraisal.matrixCaption: {tool}: domain judgements, overall, completeness and raters per study
appraisal.needRater: Enter your initials (Rater field) to open or start the appraisal.
appraisal.noMissing: Every item in scope is answered.
appraisal.notInPass: no such item in this pass
appraisal.overallPasses: Overall judgement per part (development: quality and applicability; evaluation: risk of bias and applicability)
appraisal.override: Reason for override (required: differs from the implied judgement — X017)
appraisal.overrideMissingTitle: There is an override without a reason (X017)
appraisal.overrideNeeded: Your judgement ({mine}) differs from the engine's implied judgement ({implied}). That is allowed, but state briefly why — the reason is logged as a decision in the project journal.
appraisal.overrideOk: Reason given — it is logged as a decision on save.
appraisal.pb.counting: The two passes (development: 16, evaluation: 18 signalling questions) count separately: answer keys are pass-qualified (development/1.1, evaluation/1.1), so one pass never “fills” the other. Completeness is computed by the engine (validator 1.0.0 bridge-mode counting is unreliable, H2).
appraisal.pb.holistic: Overall: HOLISTIC — PROBAST+AI has no algorithm, so you give the overall judgement and a rationale is required.
appraisal.pb.none: No PROBAST+AI appraisal yet. Enter the study and the model, then “Open”.
appraisal.pb.title: PROBAST+AI — risk of bias and applicability of prediction models
appraisal.raterHint: Your initials (e.g. SzK): your appraisal is saved under this name; the second rater works on their own machine with theirs.
appraisal.readOnly: This is {rater}'s appraisal: read-only. Open your own appraisal with your initials.
appraisal.rel.none: No unit has been appraised by two independent people yet — agreement (κ) can be computed after that.
appraisal.rel.title: Reliability of double appraisal (κ)
appraisal.rel.units: Double-rated units: {n}. Pooled by the engine — report the κ on domain judgements in the Methods.
appraisal.roConsensus: This is the consensus version: edit it in the Consensus view.
appraisal.sum.empty: No finalised (complete or consensus) appraisal for this tool and outcome yet.
appraisal.sum.impliedCell: implied (engine, not official) — no human judgement yet
appraisal.sum.impliedLegend: dashed frame: the engine's implied (conservative, not official) judgement, because there is no human judgement yet
appraisal.sum.noWeights: The weighted summary needs a primary committed run for the outcome.
appraisal.sum.svgTitle: {tool}: domain and overall judgements for {n} studies
appraisal.sum.title: Traffic light (engine summary)
appraisal.sum.weightedImplied: of which {n} studies' level is implied (not official)
appraisal.sum.weightedImpliedNote: For {n} studies the level in the weighted bars comes from the engine's implied overall judgement (no human overall judgement yet) — not an official result; record the overall judgement in the form.
appraisal.sync.confirmBody: {n} cell(s) change in column {column} of {dataset} (provenance: calculated). The change is logged and can be reverted by another save.
appraisal.sync.intro: The consensus (or single complete) overall judgement goes into the rob column of the extraction table with 'calculated' provenance — so V019 and the 'without high RoB' sensitivity run see the right value (X003). Review the preview first.
appraisal.sync.nothing: The rob column already matches the appraisals — nothing to do.
appraisal.sync.title: Syncing the rob column of the extraction table
appraisal.sync.unmatched: Appraisals without a matching table row: {list}
appraisal.tag.appliesTitle: Applies to: D = development, E = evaluation
appraisal.tag.criticalTitle: Critical item: a flaw here drives the rating down.
appraisal.tag.reverseTitle: Reverse-polarity item: here YES signals the problem.
appraisal.tag.routerTitle: Routing question: it does not worsen the judgement by itself; it only decides which later questions apply.
appraisal.targetHint: The tool's unit of assessment: {unit}. RoB 2 and ROBINS assess per result (outcome) — the same trial can be at low risk for one outcome and high for another.
appraisal.title: Risk of bias — RoB family (RoB 2, ROBINS-I/E, QUADAS-2, NOS, QUIPS, JBI)
appraisal.tr.heatCaption: TRIPOD+AI statuses per item and study
appraisal.tr.manuscriptHelp: The same check on your own prediction-model manuscript: mark per item whether it is reported (present / partial / missing / not applicable); the gap list shows what to add before submission.
appraisal.tr.missingTitle: Gap list (missing or partially reported items)
appraisal.tr.noMissing: No missing or partially reported item.
appraisal.tr.none: No TRIPOD+AI appraisal for the included studies yet.
appraisal.tr.note: TRIPOD+AI measures reporting completeness, NOT methodological soundness: a well-reported study with poor methods can still be complete.
appraisal.tr.title: TRIPOD+AI — reporting completeness (52 sub-items)
appraisal.unsavedBody: The appraisal has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you leave.
